label: SDK exception hierarchy and handling (CouchbaseException base class)
type: the SDK's typed-exception model for KV/query/general operation failures, rooted at a common base exception class (CouchbaseException in Java, an analogous hierarchy in Python) - the general case that sdk:transaction-error-handling specializes for whole-transaction commit ambiguity specifically
